ShortDescription.Value: Put your districts into groups, then assign a whole group to a service building at once.

Publish.LongDescription:
In the base game you pick which districts a service building serves. You do this for every building, one at a time. If you paint a new district or change your mind, you have to edit every building again.
District Groups makes this easier.
# BETA **This mod is in BETA.** The intial mod feature set is complete and highly optimized.
Please, if you find bugs, [report them on GitHub](https://github.com/Mordil/cs2-district-groups/issues/new).
## How to use it
1. Open the District Groups panel. 2. Make a group. Give it a name, choose a color, and pick a service type like fire or garbage. 3. Add districts to the group. 4. Select a service building. In its info panel, pick a group.
The building now serves every district in that group. Later, when you add or remove a district, every building that uses the group updates by itself.
**NOTE** It takes a few seconds after assigning a group to a building for the UI to show the change. This is the game simulation catching up.
## Localization
This mod supports all the official languages that CSII does.
Translations are provided by AI tooling, extracting from CSII localization data where possible.
If there are incorrect translations, please [report them on GitHub](https://github.com/Mordil/cs2-district-groups/issues/new).
## Things to Know
- One district can be in many groups. - A building only sees groups that match its own service type. - This mod does not change how the game works. It only fills in the "districts served" list for you. - While a building uses a group, the mod controls its district list. If you edit that list by hand, your change will be replaced.
## Mod Compatability This mod is INCOMPATIBLE with any other mod that modifies the "Operating Districts" section of a building's Info Panel.
## Uninstalling the mod
Your buildings keep serving their districts. Only the groups are lost. Loading a save without the mod is safe. But if you save the game while the mod is removed, the groups are gone for good.
## Roadmap
1. Service Building panel: See a list of all service buildings, and quickly assign them. 2. Group Info panel: View an aggregate of wealth, population, etc. of districts in the group. 3. District policy quality of life: Enable/disable district policies for all districts in a group.
Publish.ChangeLog: - Added district group metadata to the Group Management panel: district, assigned building, and population counts - Added missing tooltips to UI - Fixed the background styling of the Group Management and Group Assignment panels when using the "default" UI theme - Added a Settings button to remove all mod data from a save - Moved the Reset Settings button - Added localization for languages officially supported by the game - Group assignment selection now always lists both group sections, the type matching the building and generic groups - Removing a service building from a district group now keeps the districts it was assigned while in the group - Operating Districts are now "read-only" on the Info Panel when a service building is assigned to a district group
